Method of Attack: Abuse of wsreset.exe utility to delete arbitrary files by creating folder junctions (symlinks) pointing to privileged directories, leveraging auto-elevated privileges to delete files without detection
Bypassing antivirus software by deleting antivirus configuration and signature files to corrupt and disable antivirus protection
Privilege escalation and UAC bypass via unchecked permissions on core system files
Attack Vector: Creation of folder junctions (symbolic links) from Windows Store cache directories (e.g., INetCookies) to privileged system directories
Execution of wsreset.exe which runs with elevated privileges to delete files in linked directories
